description: Shield Rodent default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/shield_rodent-character-sheet.png: the five palette chips (intake.json swatches: light steel 189,184,181 / mid steel 129,132,138 / plate light 90,94,100 / plate dark 61,64,68 / warm taupe 121,111,107) plus direct samples of the drawn surfaces (service venv PIL, box medians; the drawn tones include the sheet's lighting, so the chips are the base tones). NO GLOW (the sheet draws none). Metallic, flat-shaded per the house rule: brushed + scratched metal = colour regions (plate / plate_sheen wedges, rim / rim_wall) + normal-map lines only.
